notes.title: Minor Update: Balancing and UI Improvements
notes.content:
Hi, players.

A minor update has been applied:
1. The number of Medkits and Sanity Pills that can be carried has been limited to one each.
2. I have increased the movement speed of the mannequins. 
3. The quantity of items in the level has been adjusted, along with the drop rates and amounts of items from enemies and boxes.
4. I've also made some UI improvements to make it more intuitive and clean.

Thank you,
Harkee

notes.title: Sanity Bug Hotfix: Values Restored to Normal
notes.content:
Hi, players.

There was a bug in the last update where sanity depleted too quickly. I have corrected the values back to their original state. I apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

Additionally, I made a few more adjustments: 
1. The flashlight's brightness has been slightly increased. 
2. The axe still seemed ineffective, so I slightly increased the collider.
3. Fixed some minor bugs

Thank you for your feedback. I will continue to carefully consider your suggestions and make improvements moving forward.
Harkee

notes.title: Update Announcement - Implementing Your Feedback
notes.content:
Hello, players!

First of all, I want to express my gratitude for all the valuable feedback you've shared with us, especially considering this is our first game with many areas still in need of improvement. Your input means the world to me, and I've been eager to address the issues you've raised to make the game better. Thank you for your continued support!

In this update, I focused on addressing your valuable feedback. Below are the key changes:

1. Combat System Improvements
Swinging the axe for long periods wasn't a fun experience, and receiving hits back and forth with zombies due to their similar attack range wasn't ideal either. I've adjusted the hitbox and motion for the axe to make it land more reliably and increased its damage for easier takedowns. Additionally, I've boosted the power of firearms, making the game a bit easier to navigate.

2. Mannequin Behavior Adjustments
Some of you mentioned that the mannequins constantly following you was a bit annoying. Now, mannequins won't follow you when your sanity is in a calm state. 

3. Changes to Medkits and Sanity Pills
I noticed that players were consuming medkits and sanity pills immediately upon finding them because they couldn't store them, leading to shortages later in the game. Now, players can store these items and use them when needed. For example, when you're being chased by a mannequin, you can use a sanity pill to stop the mannequin from pursuing you, making it easier to escape from a dangerous situation.

4. Password Puzzle Adjusted
Many players found the password puzzle too difficult to solve. I've made it more intuitive, so it's easier to figure out. Discover the change for yourself in-game!

5. Bug Fixes and UX Improvements
I've squashed several bugs that could interrupt your gameplay and worked on enhancing the overall user experience.

I hope these updates improve your overall gaming experience. I'm always listening, so please continue to share your feedback with me!

Thank you,
Harkee
